The '''University Library''' of [[Garos IV]] was a room at the [[University of Garos|University]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garos IV]].

==History==
In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the [[Gender/Legends|girl]] [[Alexandra Winger]] ran from the building towards the [[University Library|Library]] of the [[University of Garos]]. Before she arrived at the Library, she stopped to use a [[Comlink/Legends|comm]] terminal.
